Dana: Posting follow-ups from today's all-hands reliability segment. RCA link: https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/2026-03-incident-237 - please read the TL;DR.
Mohan: Quick Q - are the action items prioritized? I only see a big list.
Dana: We added P0/P1 tags in the doc. P0 = router misroute + fallback path. P1 = observability gaps and autoscaler tuning.
Elena: Obs owner for token-level breakdown?
Priya: Elena owns obs (RED-7123). Runtime (Rory) owns hotfix; infra will keep routing override until we validate.
Rory: Hotfix target 03/24 10:00 PT. I'll post PR link here after CI passes.
Mohan: For verification, I'll run: ./scripts/smoke-check --model gpt-redwood-v1 --concurrency 5 and compare token histograms.
Dana: Action list (short): 1) Runtime hotfix (Rory) 2) Routing override plan (Priya) 3) RED-7123 triage (Elena) 4) Customer comms (TBD) 5) Post-deploy verify (Mohan).
incident-bot: Reminder: incident-237 postmortem published -> https://incidents.redwood.ai/237
Dana: Please mark items you own in the RCA doc so execs can review. If you miss targets, flag now.
